question: A cyclist rides 6 km uphill at 10 km/h and straight back down at 30 km/h. What is the average speed, in km/h?
move: Average the times, not the speeds, when the distance is fixed.
trap: Averaging 10 and 30, because both legs cover the same distance.
hint: Work out how long each half takes, not how fast it is.
reference: Paulos, Innumeracy: Mathematical Illiteracy and Its Consequences, Hill and Wang, 1988
